أحتبس (form VIII)
# أَحْتَبِسُ (ʔaḥtabisu) /ʔaħ.ta.bi.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
# أُحْتَبَسُ (ʔuḥtabasu) /ʔuħ.ta.ba.su/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
# أَحْتَبِسَ (ʔaḥtabisa) /ʔaħ.ta.bi.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
# أُحْتَبَسَ (ʔuḥtabasa) /ʔuħ.ta.ba
